children: LME copper (MCU3=LX) is likely to test support at $13,943 per metric ton this week, a break below which could trigger a fall to $13,581.
The metal has broken a rising trendline and a higher support at $14,235. The break signals a completion of wave c from $12,977, which could be broken down into five smaller waves.
The next support will be at $13,943. A small inverted hammer formed on September 11. This pattern will only be considered a reversal signal if the metal can climb up and stay above $14,235.
* The copper report is published weekly on Monday.
